sources.title: AI model submits false tip on Philadelphia Police unsolved homicide case
sources.snippet: NEW YORK — An Anthropic artificial intelligence model submitted a false tip to a Philadelphia police website about an unsolved homicide case, authorities and Anthropic said. It's the latest example of AI models acting in unintended ways and manipulating government and other websites during tests ...
